prompt: Work in the provided TaskForge PowerShell CLI fixture. Inspect the existing source and tests before changing anything. Add a read-only `stats` command that reports total, pending, completed, and completion percentage rounded to one decimal using invariant formatting. Also report counts created on each UTC calendar date, ordered ascending; empty storage must produce zeros and an empty date list. Support `--json` with stable property names and types, and ensure the command never rewrites storage. Preserve all existing commands, add focused fixture-owned tests, and run the repository-owned test command. Separately create `assets/stats.txt` and integrate it so non-JSON statistics display the banner before the dashboard, while JSON output is banner-free. The asset must be exactly 12 lines, every line 20-48 characters, ASCII only, use only spaces plus `A-Z 0-9 + | / \ _ * . # ( ) : = -`, contain the literal `STATS`, have no trailing whitespace, and end with one newline.

+function Get-TaskForgeStatistics {
+    param([AllowEmptyCollection()][object[]]$Tasks = @())
+
+    $items = @($Tasks)
+    $total = $items.Count
+    $completed = @($items | Where-Object { [string]$_.status -eq 'completed' }).Count
+    $pending = $total - $completed
+
+    if ($total -eq 0) {
+        $percent = 0.0
+    }
+    else {
+        $percent = [math]::Round(($completed / [double]$total) * 100, 1)
+    }
+    $percentText = ([double]$percent).ToString('F1', [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture)
+
+    $groups = @{}
+    foreach ($item in $items) {
+        $created = [DateTimeOffset]::Parse(
+            [string]$item.createdAt,
+            [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture,
+            [System.Globalization.DateTimeStyles]::RoundtripKind)
+        $date = $created.UtcDateTime.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd', [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture)
+        if ($groups.ContainsKey($date)) {
+            $groups[$date] = $groups[$date] + 1
+        }
+        else {
+            $groups[$date] = 1
+        }
+    }
+
+    $byDate = [System.Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()
+    foreach ($key in ($groups.Keys | Sort-Object)) {
+        $byDate.Add([pscustomobject][ordered]@{
+                date  = [string]$key
+                count = [int]$groups[$key]
+            })
+    }
+
+    return [pscustomobject][ordered]@{
+        total                = [int]$total
+        pending              = [int]$pending
+        completed            = [int]$completed
+        completionPercentage = [string]$percentText
+        byDate               = [object[]]$byDate.ToArray()
+    }
+}

[CmdletBinding()]
param()

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$scriptPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'src/TaskForge.ps1'
$benchmarkRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$temporaryRoot = Join-Path $benchmarkRoot ".scratch/fixture/taskforge-base-$([guid]::NewGuid())"
$dataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.json'
$failures = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()

function Assert-True {
    param([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message)
    if (-not $Condition) {
        $failures.Add($Message)
    }
}

function Invoke-TaskForge {
    param([string[]]$Arguments)
    $output = @(& $PSHOME\pwsh -NoProfile -File $scriptPath @Arguments 2>&1)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
        Output = ($output -join "`n")
    }
}

try {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $temporaryRoot -Force | Out-Null

    $add = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'First task', '--description', 'Fixture test', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($add.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should succeed'
    $added = $add.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($added.id -eq 1 -and $added.status -eq 'pending') 'add should return a pending task with ID 1'

    $list = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($list.ExitCode -eq 0) 'list should succeed'
    Assert-True (@($list.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'list should return the stored task'

    $complete = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($complete.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete should succeed'
    Assert-True (($complete.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).status -eq 'completed') 'complete should persist completed status'

    $missing = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '99', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missing.ExitCode -ne 0) 'completing an unknown task should fail'

    $remove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($remove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'remove should succeed'
    Assert-True (($remove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedId -eq 1) 'remove should report the removed ID'

    $empty = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($empty.Output -eq 'No tasks.') 'empty list should have stable text'

    $help = Invoke-TaskForge @('help')
    Assert-True ($help.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $help.Output.Contains('TaskForge')) 'help should succeed'

    # --- stats command (read-only reporting) ---
    $statsDataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'stats-tasks.json'

    $statsEmpty = Invoke-TaskForge @('stats', '--data-file', $statsDataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($statsEmpty.ExitCode -eq 0) 'stats on empty storage should succeed'
    Assert-True (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $statsDataFile)) 'stats must not create storage for empty input'
    $emptyReport = $statsEmpty.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($emptyReport.total -eq 0 -and $emptyReport.pending -eq 0 -and $emptyReport.completed -eq 0) 'empty stats counts should all be zero'
    Assert-True ($emptyReport.completionPercentage -eq '0.0') 'empty completion percentage should be invariant 0.0'
    Assert-True (@($emptyReport.byDate).Count -eq 0) 'empty stats should produce an empty date list'

    Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'One', '--data-file', $statsDataFile) | Out-Null
    Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Two', '--data-file', $statsDataFile) | Out-Null
    Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Three', '--data-file', $statsDataFile) | Out-Null
    Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $statsDataFile) | Out-Null
    Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '2', '--data-file', $statsDataFile) | Out-Null

    $beforeBytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($statsDataFile)
    $statsFull = Invoke-TaskForge @('stats', '--data-file', $statsDataFile, '--json')
    $afterBytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($statsDataFile)
    Assert-True ($statsFull.ExitCode -eq 0) 'stats on populated storage should succeed'
    Assert-True (($beforeBytes -join ',') -eq ($afterBytes -join ',')) 'stats must not rewrite storage'
    Assert-True (($statsFull.Output -split "`n").Count -eq 1) 'json stats should be a single compact line'
    Assert-True (-not $statsFull.Output.Contains('STATS')) 'json stats output should be banner-free'

    $report = $statsFull.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($report.total -eq 3 -and $report.pending -eq 1 -and $report.completed -eq 2) 'stats counts should reflect stored tasks'
    Assert-True ($report.completionPercentage -is [string] -and $report.completionPercentage -eq '66.7') 'completion percentage should be an invariant one-decimal string'
    Assert-True ((@($report.byDate) | Measure-Object -Property count -Sum).Sum -eq 3) 'byDate counts should sum to the total task count'

    $orderedFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'ordered-tasks.json'
    $seed = @(
        [pscustomobject]@{ id = 1; title = 'a'; description = ''; status = 'completed'; createdAt = '2026-07-27T10:00:00.0000000+00:00' },
        [pscustomobject]@{ id = 2; title = 'b'; description = ''; status = 'pending'; createdAt = '2026-07-26T23:30:00.0000000+00:00' },
        [pscustomobject]@{ id = 3; title = 'c'; description = ''; status = 'pending'; createdAt = '2026-07-27T05:00:00.0000000+00:00' }
    )
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($orderedFile, (ConvertTo-Json -InputObject $seed -Depth 8) + "`n")
    $ordered = Invoke-TaskForge @('stats', '--data-file', $orderedFile, '--json')
    $orderedReport = $ordered.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    $dates = @($orderedReport.byDate | ForEach-Object { $_.date })
    Assert-True ($dates.Count -eq 2) 'distinct UTC calendar dates should be grouped'
    Assert-True ($dates[0] -eq '2026-07-26' -and $dates[1] -eq '2026-07-27') 'date list should be ordered ascending'
    Assert-True (((@($orderedReport.byDate) | Where-Object { $_.date -eq '2026-07-27' }).count) -eq 2) 'per-date counts should aggregate by UTC calendar date'

    $textStats = Invoke-TaskForge @('stats', '--data-file', $statsDataFile)
    $textLines = @($textStats.Output -split "`n")
    Assert-True ($textStats.Output.Contains('STATS')) 'non-json stats should include the STATS banner'
    $totalLineIndex = [array]::IndexOf($textLines, 'Total: 3')
    $bannerStatsIndex = -1
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $textLines.Count; $i++) {
        if ($textLines[$i] -like '*STATS*') { $bannerStatsIndex = $i; break }
    }
    Assert-True ($bannerStatsIndex -ge 0 -and $bannerStatsIndex -lt $totalLineIndex) 'STATS banner should render before the dashboard'
    Assert-True ($totalLineIndex -ge 12) 'dashboard should follow the full 12-line banner'

    if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
        $failures | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("FAIL: $_") }
        exit 1
    }
    "PASS: 26 fixture assertions (8 base + 18 stats)"
}
finally {
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
